heath:1896.author: Apollonius of Perga (ed. Sir Thomas Little Heath)
heath:1896.work: Treatise on Conic Sections, Edited in Modern Notation with Introductions Including an Essay on the Earlier History of the Subject
heath:1896.locus: Cambridge: At the University Press, 1896 (pp. clxx + 254)
heath:1896.note: Primary Public Domain English codex source: 170-page historical and mathematical introduction plus Books I–VII rendered into 147 consolidated propositions mapped to all 387 classical Greek/Arabic numbers.

heiberg:1891.author: Apollonius of Perga (ed. Johan Ludvig Heiberg)
heiberg:1891.work: Apollonii Pergaei quae Graece exstant cum commentariis antiquis, Vol. I
heiberg:1891.note: Definitive critical Greek text and Latin translation of Books I–III (and Book IV opening) based on Codex Vaticanus Graecus 206.

heiberg:1893.author: Apollonius of Perga (ed. Johan Ludvig Heiberg)
heiberg:1893.work: Apollonii Pergaei quae Graece exstant cum commentariis antiquis, Vol. II
heiberg:1893.note: Completion of Book IV, extant Greek fragments, Lemmas of Pappus (Synagoge VII), and Commentaries of Eutocius of Ascalon on Books I–IV.

halley:1710.author: Apollonius of Perga (ed. Edmond Halley)
halley:1710.work: Apollonii Pergaei Conicorum Libri Octo, et Sereni Antissensis De Sectione Cylindri & Coni Libri Duo
halley:1710.note: Monumental Oxford folio editio princeps presenting Books I–IV in Greek/Latin, Books V–VII in Latin translated from Thābit ibn Qurra's Arabic MS Bodleian Marsh 667, and Halley's conjectural Book VIII.

halley:1706.author: Apollonius of Perga (ed. Edmond Halley)
halley:1706.work: Apollonii Pergaei De Sectione Rationis Libri Duo ex Arabico MSto Latine Versi; Accedunt Ejusdem De Sectione Spatii Libri Duo Restituti
halley:1706.note: Halley's Latin translation from Bodleian Arabic MS Selden Arch. A. 34 of Apollonius's otherwise lost Cutting Off of a Ratio (Περὶ λόγου ἀποτομῆς), with restoration of Cutting Off of an Area.

nix:1889.author: Ludwig M. L. Nix
nix:1889.work: Das fünfte Buch der Conica des Apollonius von Perga in der arabischen Übersetzung des Thabit ibn Corrah
nix:1889.note: Arabic text and German translation of the Preface and opening propositions of Book V from Bodleian MS Marsh 667, cited by Heath on p. lxxiv.

balsam:1861.author: Hugo Balsam
balsam:1861.work: Des Apollonius von Perga sieben Bücher über Kegelschnitte nebst dem durch Halley wieder hergestellten achten Buche
balsam:1861.note: German translation and analytical study of Books I–VII consulted closely by Heath.

zeuthen:1886.author: Hieronymus Georg Zeuthen
zeuthen:1886.work: Die Lehre von den Kegelschnitten im Altertum
zeuthen:1886.note: Foundational historical reconstruction of Greek geometric algebra, Apollonian transformation of coordinates, and the synthesis of the Three- and Four-Line Locus.

hultsch:1877.author: Pappus of Alexandria (ed. Friedrich Hultsch)
hultsch:1877.work: Pappi Alexandrini Collectionis quae supersunt, Vol. II (Book VII: Domain of Analysis)
hultsch:1877.note: Critical Greek edition of Pappus Book VII preserving the syllabus, proposition counts, and auxiliary lemmas for Apollonius's Conics and six lost analytic treatises.

euclid:heath1908.author: Euclid (trans. Sir Thomas Little Heath)
euclid:heath1908.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements (3 vols.)
euclid:heath1908.locus: Cambridge: At the University Press, 1908 (2nd ed. 1926); GEOMETOR • euclid
euclid:heath1908.note: Third pillar of Heath's Cambridge Greek Trilogy; Books I.44, II.5–6, II.11, II.14, III.16–18, III.35–37, VI.27–29, and XII.10 underpin Apollonius's demonstrations.

archimedes:heath1897.author: Archimedes (ed. Sir Thomas Little Heath)
archimedes:heath1897.work: The Works of Archimedes, Edited in Modern Notation with Introductory Chapters
archimedes:heath1897.locus: Cambridge: At the University Press, 1897 (Supplement: The Method, 1912); GEOMETOR • archimedes
archimedes:heath1897.note: Second pillar of Heath's Cambridge Greek Trilogy, pairing Quadrature of the Parabola and On Conoids and Spheroids directly with Apollonius's symptom theory.

viete:1600.author: François Viète
viete:1600.work: Apollonius Gallus, seu Exsuscitata Apollonii Pergaei Περὶ Ἐπαφῶν Geometria
viete:1600.note: Classical Euclidean reconstruction of Apollonius's lost On Tangencies culminating in Problem X (CCC: circle tangent to three given circles).

kepler:1604.author: Johannes Kepler
kepler:1604.work: Ad Vitellionem Paralipomena, Quibus Astronomiae Pars Optica Traditur (Cap. IV, §4: De Coni Sectionibus)
kepler:1604.locus: Frankfurt: Claudius Marnius & Heirs of Johann Aubry, 1604
kepler:1604.note: Introduces the term 'foci' for Apollonius's 'points arising from the application' (III.45–52), supplies the parabola focus at finite distance with the second focus at infinity, and formulates projective continuity.

descartes:1637.author: René Descartes
descartes:1637.work: La Géométrie (Books I–II: Problem of Pappus on Three, Four, and Many Lines)
descartes:1637.note: Solves the Apollonius–Pappus Three-Line and Four-Line Locus in symbolic algebraic coordinates, inaugurating modern algebraic geometry.

kimberling:etc.author: Clark Kimberling
kimberling:etc.note: Catalogues the Isodynamic Points X(15), X(16) (intersections of the three coaxal Apollonius circles of a triangle) and the Apollonius Point X(181) (perspector of the outer Soddy/Apollonius CCC contact triangle).

wildberger:2005.author: Norman J. Wildberger
wildberger:2005.work: Divine Proportions: Rational Trigonometry to Universal Geometry
wildberger:2005.note: Reformulates classical Apollonian conics, focus-directrix quadrances, and projective polarity purely over arbitrary fields without transcendental functions.

mathlib4:polepolar.author: Lean Community (mathlib4)
mathlib4:polepolar.note: Formalizes bilinear symmetric polarity, self-polar triangles, and harmonic cross-ratio division corresponding directly to Apollonius Conics Book III Props. 30–40.
